interface.longDescription: Live, fixed prices for private airport transfers in the UK and 90+ markets: airport to hotel, address or city centre, one-way or return. Every price includes 60 minutes' free waiting after your flight lands, express pick-up at the airport's designated point, no meter and no surge, and free cancellation until 24 hours before pick-up. Compare vehicles from saloon to 16-seater, then finish the booking on airporttaxihub.com, where the flight number, exact address and any extras are added. Prices in chat are the same as on the website.
